inner_split_source: revision_2026/03_corrected_protocol/corrected_split_assignment.csv using outer_role=outer_train and inner_role labels with purged_inner_boundary rows excluded from inner_train

preprocessing_method.feature_assembly: submitted build_ulsan_npz-style feature construction with dropna on required features and target
preprocessing_method.scaler: StandardScaler fit only on training partition for each fit

selection_rule: For each horizon and outer_fold, evaluate every candidate (alpha, l1_ratio) by fitting scaler plus ElasticNet on purged inner_train rows and scoring MAE on inner_validation rows from corrected split assignment; choose the config with minimum inner_validation_MAE.
tie_break_rule: If multiple candidates tie on inner_validation_MAE within absolute tolerance 1e-12, select smallest alpha; if alpha also ties, select smallest l1_ratio; no outer_test outcomes are viewed before final config lock.
h5_v2_lineage_note: H5 v2 exists as a fixed-context enet_a0.1_l0.5_v2 artifact and is treated as provenance context only, not as corrected nested selection authority.
